change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md, sections 2 and 11. Decided: (1) A canvas surface on basalt-ui/cards: content placed by the app (a CSS grid of columns, never free nodes), a transform for pan and zoom, a dot ground from tokens. Pointer and hand tools in a floating toolbar (H and V keys, `aria-pressed`); drag on empty ground pans in both; wheel pans, Ctrl or Cmd with wheel and pinch zoom; a zoom menu with 50, 100, 125 per cent and fit, range 0.5 to 1.25 by default. Built on `useChainViewport`, which moves to a shared module; `ChainView` keeps its API and runs on it. (2) A group card: header with icon, title, a chip and a menu, a body of rows (44 px class, from the ladder) that collapses to the header and remembers its fold; rows are focusable and carry an anchor id. (3) A connector layer: one SVG over the content drawing elbow edges with rounded corners and an arrowhead between anchors (`from`, `to` as anchor ids), re-measured on resize, fold and zoom; the path code is `chainLayout`'s, exported once. Edges are decoration, not hit targets. (4) Validation: one `issues` input keyed by group, row and edge; a group header shows a warning chip with the count, the row a warning mark, the edge the warn tone, and the docked panel a checklist that focuses the row on click. Tone comes from `Status`'s `Tone`, never a new colour. (5) The docked details panel is `PageAside` beside the canvas, the canvas shrinking, not covered. (6) Keyboard: Tab walks groups and rows in source order; zoom keys work while the canvas has focus. (7) Phone: no zoom, no edges, no dock; groups stack in source order. (8) After landing, file a signal to software-factory (`factory signal file --repo software-factory`) naming the exports for the console's chain graph. The proof page sits on the parts-inventory domain of the reference pages (apps/playground/src/routes/ref/, its fixtures and fixed today) and compiles on the playground's app lint preset with zero basalt waivers; if packages/basalt-ui/blocks/ exists when you start (bench-blocks landed), ship the page as a block instead of a route. The domain's flow is a reorder workflow: trigger, conditions, approval, purchase order.
reference: workflows.md 2.4 and 4: canvas 1386x858 with the panel hidden, 1026x858 docked; docked aside 360 with an 8 px resize strip, content padding 24 and 20, block gap 32, row pitch 30, label column 124; floating toolbar 301x46, 20 from the bottom; stage 1180 wide, columns 300, 340, 320, row gap 20, column gap about 86; dots 18x18 grid, 1 px at 10 per cent; edges 1.5 stroke, about 27 lead-out, 12 corner radius, arrowhead 6x8, amber when the target has an issue, no labels, not clickable; group tray radius 12, padding 4, header 36, rows min 44, folded 46; header chip 20 high, radius 6; validation: amber header chip, amber edge, row triangle, a panel checklist, a details count; phone: groups 358 wide in source order, no zoom, edges or dock. Their weak spots: Cmd+0, Cmd+plus and undo did nothing.
